properties.name: Fertile Crescent
properties.source: Simplified by hand (0.05 deg) after the general shape of published maps of the Fertile Crescent: J. H. Breasted, Ancient Times (1916), who named the region, and the Wikimedia Commons map 'Fertile Crescent map.png'. A teaching outline, not a survey: from the Persian Gulf up the Tigris and Euphrates, along the Taurus foothills, down the Levant coast to the Nile delta.
